title: Fiverr Pro vs Regular Sellers: Is the Difference Worth It?
h1: Fiverr Pro vs regular sellers: is the difference worth it?
description: How Vetted Pro sellers compare with other Fiverr sellers on price, ratings and reviews, based on 665 sellers we checked, and when paying more makes sense.
intro: Fiverr marks some sellers as Vetted Pro after reviewing their work and experience. They usually cost more than other sellers in the same category. Is the difference worth it? We looked at the 665 sellers we feature across our hiring guides, compared starting prices, ratings and review counts, and put together a simple way to decide.

faq.a: It is a badge Fiverr gives to sellers it has reviewed for quality and professional experience. It narrows the field but is not a guarantee of fit.

faq.q: What are Level 2 and Top Rated?
faq.a: They are seller levels Fiverr assigns based on track record, such as completed orders, ratings and on-time delivery.
No. In some categories, experienced non-Pro sellers with thousands of reviews deliver excellent work at much lower prices.

faq.q: Why did you feature mostly Pro sellers?
faq.a: Our selection rule puts Vetted Pro sellers first and adds other sellers only when there are not enough Pro sellers who meet our bar.

faq.q: Can I negotiate with a Pro seller?
faq.a: You can request a custom offer for your exact scope. Many sellers prefer that to a mismatched package.
